reports.title: Prestige Consumer Healthcare Inc. Reports Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter Results

guidance.heading: Updated Fiscal 2027 Outlook
section: Ron Lombardi, Chief Executive Officer, stated, "We are updating our fiscal 2027 outlook for revenues to $1,280 million to $1,290 million and adjusted diluted EPS of $4.48 to $4.55 primarily to reflect recent variability in Clear Eyes® production at Pillar5, which is expected to reduce product availability and revenue in the second half. While supply remains limited for Clear Eyes®, we continue to invest in our Pillar5 production site with the intent of delivering consistent quality output that generates long-term growth for the brand."

"It's important to note that our outlook for the remainder of the portfolio is unchanged, with the base business delivering growth and our recent acquisitions on track to deliver sales and profit consistent with our prior guidance. Against a challenging consumer environment, this is a testament to our trusted brands and diversified business model."

“We remain confident in our business, the strategic investments we have made over the past twelve months, and our medium-term outlook for approximately 10% annual revenue growth, approximately 8% annual EPS growth, and nearly $900 million of aggregate free cash flow over the next three years. The acquisitions of Breathe Right® and LaCorium provide attractive long-term growth opportunities as we integrate these brands into our portfolio. The acquisition of Pillar5 will provide vertical integration of our eye care supply chain and an important platform for continued investment in capacity, reliability and long-term growth. Together, these investments further strengthen our diversified portfolio and financial profile while supporting strong free cash flow, debt reduction and future capital deployment,” Mr. Lombardi concluded.

Previous Fiscal 2027 Outlook | Current Fiscal 2027 Outlook
Revenue | $1,290 to $1,315 million | $1,280 to $1,290 million
Organic Revenue Growth | +1.0% to +3.0% | ~ Flat
Adjusted Diluted E.P.S. | $4.55 to $4.65 | $4.48 to $4.55
Adjusted Free Cash Flow | $270 million or more | $265 million or more
Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Conference Call, Accompanying Slide Presentation and Replay

The Company will host a conference call to review its second quarter and first half fiscal 2027 results today, November 5, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET. The Company provides a live Internet webcast, a slide presentation to accompany the call, as well as an archived replay, all of which can be accessed from the Investor Relations page of the Company's website at http://www.prestigeconsumerhealthcare.com. To participate in the conference call via phone, participants may register for the call here to receive dial-in details and a unique pin. While not required, it is recommended to join 10 minutes prior to the event start. The slide presentation can be accessed from the Investor Relations page of the Company’s website by clicking on Webcasts and Presentations.
